response.goal: Build an n8n-based lead routing system that automates intake from website demo forms, pricing-page chat, webinar CSVs, and partner referral emails, cleans and validates leads, merges duplicates in PostgreSQL, enriches them, assigns them to reps via round-robin or enterprise rules, notifies reps in Slack with escalation, and maintains a Google Sheet mirror.

plan.step: Design and apply SQL migration files for the PostgreSQL schema including leads, touchpoints, assignments, dead-letter, and configuration tables.
Build n8n intake workflows for website demo form webhooks, chat tool webhooks, Google Drive webinar CSV polling, and partner referral inbox parsing.
Implement validation, normalization, and duplicate handling logic to merge existing leads or treat old closed lost leads as fresh.
Integrate the enrichment provider API while respecting rate limits, and implement routing rules for enterprise accounts and region-based round-robins.
Set up Slack notifications, 30-minute claim/reassignment timers, Google Sheet real-time mirroring, error handling, dead-letter retry queues, and daily digests.
Write the README documentation, compile the architecture diagram, and conduct the handover call and testing with 50 test leads.

milestones.name: Milestone 1
milestones.deliverable: Intake from all four sources, validation, duplicate handling, and PostgreSQL storage, with the Google Sheet mirror.

milestones.deliverable: Enrichment, routing rules, Slack notifications, claiming, and reassignment.

risks.risk: Partner referral emails arrive in 15 different unformatted structures, which could cause high failure rates in parsing.
risks.mitigation: Route unparsable emails into a dedicated review queue and handle them gracefully without dropping any leads.

risks.risk: Concurrent lead arrivals could create race conditions and unfairness in the round-robin assignment pointer.
risks.mitigation: Store the round-robin pointer securely in PostgreSQL with proper locking or atomic updates.

questions: What specific email parsing rules or keywords should be prioritized for the 15 different partner referral formats?
What is the exact API specification and authentication method for the external enrichment provider?
assumptions: The client will provide access to the staging PostgreSQL database and n8n instance as stated.
Sample files and the country-to-region mapping table will be made available promptly during the first week.
